# Regression test for https://go.dev/issue/58767:
# with an empty go.work file in GKPATH mode, calls to load.defaultGODEBUG for a
# package named "main" panicked in modload.MainModules.GoVersion.

env GK111MODULE=off
cd example
go list example/m

-- example/go.work --
go 1.21
-- example/m/main.go --
package main
func main() {}
